text: ᱡᱚᱦᱟᱨ
notes: Universal greeting / respectful salutation; essential phoneme baseline

text: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ
notes: Language self-designation with retroflex flap 'ᱲ' and checked vowel

text: ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱫᱟᱨᱟᱢ
notes: Welcome phrase containing ahad 'ᱹ' diacritic on 'ᱥᱟᱹ'

text: ᱟᱢ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ-ᱟ?
notes: Standard conversational question 'How are you?' featuring checked consonant 'ᱜ' and glottal hyphen

text: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱪᱮᱫ?
notes: Question 'What is your name?' featuring palatal nasal 'ᱧ' (U+1C66)

text: ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱮᱥ ᱜᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱹᱧᱟ ᱾
notes: Response 'I am fine' featuring diacritic ahad 'ᱹ' in 'ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱹᱧᱟ'

text: ᱟᱞᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱯᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱫᱟᱨᱟᱢ ᱾
notes: Long declarative sentence 'Welcome to our village' testing prosodic rhythm across multi-word clauses

text: ᱫᱟᱨᱟᱭ ᱠᱟᱱ ᱵᱟᱪᱷᱱᱟᱣ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱵᱷᱳᱴ ᱮᱢ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱥᱟᱯᱲᱟᱣ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱠᱚᱣᱟ ᱾
notes: Complex multi-clause administrative sentence testing sustained neural pitch and breath modeling

text: ᱱᱚᱣᱟ ᱯᱚᱛᱚᱵ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱠᱟᱹᱦᱱᱤ ᱚᱞ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
notes: Educational sentence testing checked consonant 'ᱜ' in 'ᱟᱹᱰᱤ' and 'ᱚᱞ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ'

text: ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ ᱾
notes: Imperative instruction 'Go home' with retroflex 'ᱲ' and checked vowel 'ᱮ'

text: ᱫᱩᱲᱩᱵ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱯᱚᱛᱚᱵ ᱯᱟᱲᱦᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ ᱾
notes: Compound classroom instruction 'Sit down and read the Santali book'

text: ᱥᱟᱯᱷᱟ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱩᱭ ᱢᱮ ᱾
notes: Healthcare instruction 'Drink clean water'

text: ᱦᱟᱥᱯᱟᱛᱟᱞ ᱫᱚ ᱚᱠᱟᱨᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ-ᱟ?
notes: Clinical query 'Where is the hospital?'

text: ᱥᱤᱠᱤᱞ ᱥᱮᱞ ᱢᱟᱭᱟᱢ ᱵᱤᱰᱟᱹᱣ
provenance: Bhasha Setu Sickle Cell Screening Mission
notes: Medical diagnostic term 'Sickle cell blood test'

text: ᱨᱩᱣᱟᱹ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱫᱟᱠᱛᱚᱨ ᱴᱷᱮᱱ ᱥᱮᱱᱚᱜ ᱢᱮ ᱾
notes: Clinical guidance 'If you have fever, consult a doctor'

text: ᱛᱮᱦᱮᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱥᱟᱛᱟᱢ ᱵᱚᱱ ᱯᱟᱲᱦᱟᱣᱟ?
notes: Teacher query 'What topic will we study today?'

text: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱛᱟ ᱩᱫᱩᱜ ᱢᱮ ᱾
notes: Classroom instruction 'Show your notebook'

text: ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱜᱤᱫᱽᱨᱟᱹ ᱱᱤᱛᱚᱜ ᱪᱩᱯ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱ ᱯᱮ ᱾
notes: Classroom command 'All children remain quiet now'
Pure Ol Chiki digits 0 through 9 (sunye, mit, bar, pe, pune, more, turui, eae, iral, are)

text: ᱢᱤᱫ, ᱵᱟᱨ, ᱯᱮ, ᱯᱩᱱ, ᱢᱚᱬᱮ, ᱛᱩᱨᱩᱭ, ᱮᱟᱭ, ᱤᱨᱟᱹᱞ, ᱟᱨᱮ, ᱜᱮᱞ ᱾
notes: Ol Chiki cardinal number words 1 through 10

text: ᱒᱐᱒᱖ ᱥᱮᱨᱢᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱕᱐ ᱜᱚᱴᱟᱝ ᱜᱤᱫᱽᱨᱟᱹ ᱤᱥᱠᱩᱞ ᱠᱚ ᱦᱤᱡᱩᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
notes: Sentence combining Ol Chiki multi-digit numerals with text (year 2026, 50 children)

text: ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱠᱟᱹᱴᱤᱡ ᱪᱮᱬᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱩᱰᱟᱹᱣᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
notes: Sentence with dense retroflex flaps and nasal glides: 'ᱟᱹᱰᱤ', 'ᱠᱟᱹᱴᱤᱡ', 'ᱪᱮᱬᱮ', 'ᱩᱰᱟᱹᱣᱜ'

text: ᱵᱤᱫᱽᱭᱟᱞᱚᱭ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱥᱮᱪᱮᱫ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱡᱟᱹᱨᱩᱲ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
notes: Tests conjunct borrow 'ᱵᱤᱫᱽᱭᱟᱞᱚᱭ' alongside native checked suffixes 'ᱥᱮᱪᱮᱫ' and diacritic 'ᱡᱟᱹᱨᱩᱲ'

text: ᱢᱟᱭᱟᱢ ᱵᱤᱰᱟᱹᱣ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱚᱨᱡᱚ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱦᱮᱡ ᱮᱱᱟ ᱾
notes: Tests technical healthcare terms with ahad diacritics: 'ᱵᱤᱰᱟᱹᱣ' (test/examination) and 'ᱚᱨᱡᱚ' (result)

text: Johar, am do ched leka menag-a?
notes: Standard conversational Santali written in Roman script without diacritics

text: Aleyag aatu re apeyag sagun daram.
notes: Formal greeting in Roman script

text: Nui do gai kanay. Nui do dangra kanay.
notes: Basic declarative pair verified from parallel dictionary

text: ᱟᱢ classroom ᱛᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ ᱾
notes: Code-switched school command with English noun 'classroom' embedded in Ol Chiki grammar

text: ᱰᱟᱠᱛᱟᱨ hospital ᱨᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱭᱟ ᱾
notes: Santali loan word 'ᱰᱟᱠᱛᱟᱨ' combined with English Latin word 'hospital' and Ol Chiki locative 'ᱨᱮ'

text: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱟᱨ Hindi ᱵᱟᱱᱟᱨ ᱯᱟᱹᱨᱥᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱨᱚᱲ ᱢᱮ ᱾
provenance: Bhasha Setu Migrant Teacher Training Corpus
notes: Multi-script multilingual instruction targeting bilingual classroom interactions
